verdict.line: You lose if Riven dumps her full burst into you before level 6 and you have no answer to the knockback; you win if you survive to Needlework range and out-scale through items.

brief.thesis: Riven's entire kit is burst windows gated by cooldowns you can see expire — Q (Broken Wings, 13s cooldown) and W (Ki Burst, 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown) both have to be up at the same time for her all-in to work. Gwen has no dash to escape a stun, only Hallowed Mist to deny being targeted, so the matchup is decided by whether you poke her cooldowns down with Q (Snip Snip!) before she can line up Q into W.

theirWindow.when: Q and W both off cooldown, level 1-6
theirWindow.what: She can Ki Burst to stun then chain Broken Wings for full combo damage with no way for you to escape since you have no dash. Pop W (Hallowed Mist) the instant she commits so she either backs off or has to walk into the mist to hit you.

yourWindow.when: her Q and W are both down
yourWindow.what: Walk up and land as many Snip Snip! cones as you can — true damage to the center target plus passive stacks — since she has nothing but Valor (E) to block one instance before she has to just eat it.

powerCurve.note: Ki Burst stun threatens trades you can't dash out of
Full combo online, solo-kill risk highest here

Full burst combo one-shots through Valor block

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Sustain and mana for repeated Snip Snip! pokes let you contest trades without all-in'ing into her stun.

boots.why: Riven's damage is almost entirely basic-attack-reliant through Runic Blade charges; the flat reduction blunts her all-in harder than Sorcerer's Shoes helps your poke.

core.why: Core scaling piece that starts the build in 67.4% of winning games on this matchup.
Spikes burst damage right as your power curve overtakes hers from level 11 on.
Caps the AP scaling so your Needlework and passive procs start one-shotting through her reduced HP pool.

situational.when: she is landing her full Q-W combo on you reliably and you need to survive her all-in window
the game goes long and you need sustained DPS in extended skirmishes rather than burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained trading pattern of poking with Snip Snip! and sticking during E (Skip 'n Slash) windows rather than one burst all-in.

summoners.why: Exhaust directly answers her burst window by cutting the damage and tenacity on her Q-into-W all-in, and at 52% win rate with 26.7% pick it outperforms the Ignite line specifically because this matchup is about surviving her spike, not racing a kill.

playing.title: Track her Q and W cooldowns
playing.detail: Her all-in requires both up. If either is down, you can walk up and trade freely with Snip Snip!.

playing.title: Pop Hallowed Mist on her commit
playing.detail: W only lets enemies who enter the mist target you, so timing it as she dashes in with Q denies the follow-up stun-into-damage.

playing.title: Poke, don't all-in, before level 6
playing.detail: Snip Snip! has a 6.5-3.5s cooldown depending on rank and deals true damage to the center target — use it to whittle her down from range where her Broken Wings can't reach.

playing.title: Use E (Skip 'n Slash) to disengage after trades
playing.detail: The dash plus attack speed window lets you reset spacing immediately after a Snip Snip! poke, keeping you outside her 275-range Q.

playing.title: Save W for her stun, not her poke
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist's 22-18s cooldown is too long to waste on chip damage — hold it specifically for the Ki Burst stun setup.

playing.title: All-in once Needlework is rank 2
playing.detail: At levels 11+ your burst from Needlework plus passive stacks starts outscaling anything Valor can block.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability interactions, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis, not sourced from the data.
